capabilities: Show a floating toolbar near selected editor text
Apply inline formatting such as bold, italic, highlight, code, and links
Convert selections into quotes, lists, code blocks, and callouts
Transform selection case to uppercase, lowercase, or title case
Extract selected text into a new note linked with a wikilink
extras: Works fully locally with no network requests; supports desktop and mobile; requires Obsidian 1.1.0 or later.
problem: Obsidian's editor has no selection-triggered toolbar, so applying inline, block, and case formatting to selected text requires memorizing shortcuts or digging through menus.
summary: Floating toolbar that appears on text selection to apply Markdown formatting, block conversions, case transforms, and extract-to-note actions.
